description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “Ocean Ayer”, an exceptional Seacrest Beach retreat designed for unforgettable 30A escapes with family and friends. Ideally positioned between the iconic communities of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, this expansive coastal home combines a beautifully appointed main house and carriage house, creating the perfect setting for large groups who want both space and connection. Spend sun-filled days lounging at the famous 12,000 sq ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool, biking along scenic 30A with the 9 included bikes, or hopping on the seasonal tram for effortless beach days. With inviting living spaces, multiple balconies for soaking in the coastal breeze and thoughtful amenities throughout, Ocean Ayer offers the perfect balance of comfort, elegance and relaxed 30A living. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Main house and carriage house with 6 bedrooms and 6.5 bathrooms, ideal for large families and groups traveling togetherSleeps 18 comfortably with spacious sleeping arrangements across multiple levelsAccess to the iconic 12,000 sq ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool, one of the largest and most beautiful pools on 30APrivate community beach access with seasonal tram service for effortless beach days9 bikes included for exploring scenic 30A, Rosemary Beach and Alys BeachMultiple balconies and porches designed for relaxing with the coastal breezeGourmet kitchen with stand-alone ice maker and generous island seatingGas grill perfect for sunset cookouts after beach and pool days*** LIVING AREAS ***Step inside “Ocean Ayer” and discover inviting living spaces designed for relaxing and gathering after sun-filled days along 30A. The main living room offers comfortable coastal furnishings and a welcoming atmosphere perfect for conversation or movie nights. Additional lounge areas throughout the home give guests space to spread out and unwind, including a cozy living room in the carriage house.Spacious main living area with comfortable seating and flat-screen TVAdditional sitting area ideal for movie nights or relaxed eveningsCarriage house living room with ample seating for lounging and flat-screen TVMultiple balconies and porches offering peaceful outdoor lounging*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The chef-inspired kitchen is designed to make cooking and entertaining a pleasure. With generous counter space, high-end appliances and a large island perfect for gathering, it’s an inviting space where guests can prepare meals, share stories and linger over dinner long after the sun sets. The carriage house also features a secondary kitchen, providing added convenience and flexibility for larger groups.Stainless steel appliances and granite countertopsStand-alone ice maker perfect for beach coolers and pool daysOversized island with seating for 6Dining area with seating for 6+ ideal for group meals and celebrationsSecondary kitchen in the carriage house for added convenience*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***“Ocean Ayer” offers a collection of inviting outdoor spaces where guests can fully embrace the relaxed rhythm of 30A living. Sip coffee on a balcony in the morning sunshine, gather for dinner fresh off the grill or enjoy the easy walk to the lagoon pool and beach access.Multiple porches and balconies across three levelsGas grill for relaxed outdoor diningSteps from the stunning 12,000 sq ft Seacrest Lagoon PoolConvenient access to private community beach access*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With 6 bedrooms and 6.5 bathrooms, “Ocean Ayer” comfortably accommodates up to 18 guests while offering both privacy and flexibility throughout the home.Main House1st FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, porch access and En-suite with single vanity, walk-in shower and soaking tubPowder Room: Conveniently located off the kitchen area2nd FloorBunk Room: Two twin-over-twin bunk beds and flat-screen TVGuest Bathroom: Single vanity and shower/tub comboBunk Nook: Twin-over-twin bunkKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower3rd FloorKing Guest Suite: King Murphy bed, sectional sofa, flat-screen TV and kitchenette with mini fridge and microwaveGuest Bathroom: Single vanity and walk-in showerCarriage HousePrimary King Suite: King bed, balcony access and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerBunk Area: Twin-over-twin bunk, perfect for kids or additional guests*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled in the heart of Seacrest Beach, “Ocean Ayer” places guests just moments from some of the most beloved destinations along 30A. From boutique shopping to award-winning dining and breathtaking Gulf beaches, everything you need for an unforgettable vacation is within easy reach.Lagoon Pool: 12,000 sq ft resort-style pool with waterfalls, splash zone and plenty of loungersPrivate Beach Access: Quick bike ride or seasonal tram ride to the GulfPeddler’s Pavilion: Nearby hub for dining, shops and live musicScenic walking trails throughout the Seacrest communityEasy bike ride to both Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentThis property includes 9 bikes for guest use. A waiver must be signed before the bike code is providedLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest or Alys BeachTDT #: 40754STRO #: STR-040754 Read less
